r0.why: Definition from [1], intrinsic repeating symmetric patterns from [2], symmetry as defining property and invariance under operations from [44][45].

r1.why: Smallest repeating group [3] with full symmetry [11], built by repeated translation along axes [4], translations define Bravais lattice nodes [5]; tile comparison adds no fact.

r2.why: Parallelepiped with six parameters a,b,c and angles [12][6], fractional coordinates from a reference point [13], asymmetric unit [14] with other particles generated by symmetry operations [16].

r3.why: Space group as set of symmetry operations [17][7], 230 space groups [8], unique principal axis and basal plane [38][39], arbitrary axes with no principal axis [40].

r4.why: Miller indices h,k,l [18][19], intercepts a1/h etc. and inverse proportionality [20][21], zero means no intersection [22], integers no common factor [24], bar for negatives [25], angle-bracket families [41].

r5.why: Properties like cleavage, band structure, transparency [9]; cleavage and dislocation glide parallel to denser planes [33][34]; adsorption/reactions at surface depend on node density [28][29].
